displayDescription: Coloured-pencil hatching builds a lightbulb, then its outer layer peels back to show a labelled red network inside.
audioDescription: Silent preview: no music, sound effects or narration.
limitations: STYLE.json has no reviewed preview recipes and no BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json was supplied, so the preview shows the Motion Graphic's main action: build the specimen with overlapping hatches, then peel back one layer to show the labelled interior.

Coloured pencil is approximated procedurally: seeded Canvas 2D strokes with a cached noise grain knocked out of them, over a cached paper-tooth texture. It is not scanned pencil or physically simulated pigment.
The paper peel is a 2D fold: distances across the hinge are scaled by cos(angle) and shaded. There is no true 3D curl, bending or self-shadowing.
No Blender was used, as instructed. Rendering is Canvas 2D and timing is a single GSAP timeline.

The dependency-record tool (select_project_technologies) could not run because this preview project has no PROJECT_DEPENDENCIES.json. Canvas 2D is a browser feature and GSAP is the supplied local gsap.min.js, so nothing was installed.
